negative_findings.description: Targeted uk-language searching for oblast military administrations procuring cash-handling equipment, ATMs or cash desks returned only generic ОВА procurement pages and no concrete tender records for банкомат / обладнання для обслуговування готівки.
negative_findings.result_summary: ОВА sites confirm a 'публічні закупівлі' section pattern, but no cash-infrastructure line items surfaced at search-engine level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Such purchases likely exist but are only discoverable by CPV-level querying inside Prozorro/Spending, not via web search; the collection design must not rely on search engines for this layer.

negative_findings.description: Defence Procurement Agency (ДОТ) states that certain procurement information is not disclosed publicly under martial-law legislation; there appears to be no public itemised register of its closed purchases.
negative_findings.result_summary: MoD explanation pages describe information-security regime rather than publishing procurement detail.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A structurally significant share of spend is legally unobservable in real time; only post-hoc audit reports (Рахункова палата) and deferred Prozorro reporting can partially close this gap.

negative_findings.description: Could not retrieve a definitive, itemised list of exemption grounds (the specific numbered points of Resolution 1178 permitting direct contracts) from secondary sources; commentary confirms the list has been repeatedly expanded but summaries are partial.
negative_findings.result_summary: Trade press confirms expansion of direct-contract grounds; exact enumeration not captured in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The exemption enumeration is the backbone for classifying observed contracts; it must be read directly from the consolidated act text rather than commentary.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated English-language authoritative source was found for the wartime exemption regime; English coverage is confined to NGO/analysis summaries (TI Ukraine, law-firm briefings).
negative_findings.result_summary: English sources are derivative, not primary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that uk-language collection is mandatory for this cell; an English-only pipeline would systematically miss the regime.

coverage_gaps.description: Buyer EDRPOU codes were confirmed only for a few entities (Ukrposhta 21560045, Ukrenergo 00100227, ДОТ 44725823); Ukrzaliznytsia and the 24 oblast administrations were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a canonical buyer registry (name, EDRPOU, site, procurement URL) for all reconstruction-programme buyers before collection starts.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code map yet for payment and cash infrastructure as bought under non-banking classifications (cash registers, POS terminals, ATMs, cash-handling machines, self-service kiosks, ticketing).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compile a CPV shortlist (e.g. 30142000 cash registers, 30144200 ticket-issuing machines, 302xxxxx computing/office equipment, 66xxxxxx financial services, 51xxxxxx installation) and query Prozorro by CPV rather than by keyword.

coverage_gaps.description: Sub-threshold purchases (below UAH 50,000) are neither planned nor published in the e-system at all; no source found that captures them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Approach this layer only via Spending.gov.ua treasury transactions and buyer financial reports; treat it as structurally unobservable in tender data.

coverage_gaps.description: Deferred-disclosure contracts (published 10 business days after signature, or up to 90 days after martial law ends for urgent defence needs) create a moving backlog not yet modelled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design collection to re-scan historical periods repeatedly, since records appear retroactively; record first-seen vs contract-date separately.

coverage_gaps.description: Not yet explored: AMCU appeals body (Колегія АМКУ) decisions, NABU/SAPO case materials, and donor-side procurement rules (World Bank, EBRD, EU Ukraine Facility) which govern reconstruction purchases outside national rules.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up pass covering AMCU appeal decisions and IFI/donor procurement notice boards for Ukraine reconstruction projects.

brief: Ukraine's special and restricted procurement regimes are legally centralised in CMU Resolution 1178 and its frequent amendments, so the primary sources are the act texts (zakon.rada.gov.ua, kmu.gov.ua, me.gov.ua) plus Prozorro's own guidance on how exempt and defence purchases are reported back into the system as 'звіт про договір' records. Because a material share of wartime spend never appears as a competitive tender, the highest-value observation points are the Prozorro API's reporting-procedure records, treasury payments on Spending.gov.ua/Є-Data, and post-hoc audit output from Держаудитслужба and Рахункова палата. Reconstruction-programme buyers — Ukrposhta, Ukrzaliznytsia, Ukrenergo and the oblast military administrations — publish on their own portals and buy payment-acceptance, ticketing and cash-desk equipment under transport, postal and IT classifications, so CPV-based rather than keyword-based querying is essential, complemented by the DREAM ecosystem for forward pipeline. Defence Procurement Agency (ДОТ) purchases are largely closed by law and remain a structural blind spot addressable only through audit reports and deferred disclosure.
